page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top centre. Two epitaph blocks of verse separated by decorative rules, each with a heading; no margin notes; no page number printed.

l.i: Falleris: Heroum stat sine fine decus.
Viuus enim qui sex Siguitque stetitque columnis,
Mortuus hic nulla morte iacere potest.
Hinc pietas, doctrina, fides, prudentia, robur
Mentis, & in patria non simulatus amor
Et stantem nulla parte iacere sinunt.
Nos contra Vobis, Ioachimi in funere, Musæ,
Namque omnes tecum, tecum, Ioachime, Camænæ
Vt Svixere simul, sic periere simul.

page.notes: Several words in the verses are heavily worn; "Siguit" and "Svixere" and "Pabembergensis" are uncertain. Long s rendered as s throughout. The Greek letters in the first line are not distinguishable and the heading text is transcribed as printed.
